item.description:
First public build of Stackshot.
- Stackshot now updates itself: it checks for new versions once a day, and **Check for Updates…** is in the menu bar menu. - Runs on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs with macOS 15 or later.
**Install:** open `Stackshot-0.14.0.dmg`, drag Stackshot to Applications, and open it. macOS will ask for Screen Recording permission the first time you capture.
